A.text: Immunosuppression may be deliberately sought to prevent rejection of a transplant, or may result from chemotherapy or HSCT conditioning.

B.text: It can be a deliberate therapeutic goal, so calling it always unintended is wrong.

C.text: HSCT conditioning is also a recognized cause of immunosuppression.

cites.section: Dental Management of Pediatric Patients Receiving Immunosuppressive › Purpose

D.text: It may also be a consequence of chemotherapy or HSCT conditioning, so it is not solely intended.
